body: A real cat: soft fur with direction and individual whiskers, ears that rotate toward sounds, pupils that widen in dim light and narrow in bright, a tail that flicks and curls with mood, slow blinks when content, a stretch with the back arched, silent padded steps, a light graceful jump landing front paws first.

A real dog: wet nose, panting tongue, ears that perk up or flop, a tail that wags with the whole back end when happy, a head tilt when curious, a shake from head to tail after water that throws droplets, paws with visible pads and nails, breathing visible in the chest.

Arabian horse: refined wedge-shaped head with a dished face profile, large dark eyes, arched neck, high-carried tail, glossy coat (grey, bay, chestnut) showing muscles and veins, flowing mane; snorts, ears swivel, hooves lift high and light.

Birds: wings flap with a downstroke and upstroke, feathers spread at the tips, landing with wings braked and legs forward; pigeons flock on rooftops and squares and bob their heads when walking; a falcon on a gloved arm with a hood, sharp curved beak, intense eyes, wings spreading wide; seagulls glide over the water.

Camel: long curved neck, a single hump (dromedary), long legs with knobbly knees, padded wide feet, long eyelashes, chewing slowly with the jaw moving sideways; it sits by folding the front legs first, then the back, and rises back legs first; desert caravans with decorated saddles.

Livestock: sheep with thick wool and dirty-cream fleece moving as a flock, a shepherd with a stick; goats climbing and jumping; water buffalo in the southern marshes wallowing in water with only heads and backs visible, curved horns, and boys riding or herding them.

Fish and sea life: fish with scales that flash in light, fins moving to steer, schools turning together; dolphins arc out of the water with a splash; underwater scenes have blue-green colour, light rays from the surface and floating particles.

Iraqi southern marshes (Ahwar): flat mirror-like water with tall green-golden reeds, mudhif guesthouses built entirely of arched reed bundles, mashoof canoes poled through channels, water buffalo, birds rising from reeds, soft hazy light at sunrise.

Desert: wind-sculpted dunes with sharp crests and soft ripples, sand blowing off the ridges, footprints that sink and slide, heat shimmer on the horizon, long shadows at golden hour, a vast clear sky; Iraqi western desert is flatter with stony ground and scattered shrubs.

Mountains: layered ridges fading into blue haze with distance, rocky slopes with oak and pine trees, a river or waterfall with white water and mist, clouds catching on peaks; the air looks clean and the light shifts as clouds pass.

Gardens and parks: green grass with uneven blades, trees with leaves moving in the breeze and dappled light through them, flowers in beds, families on picnic blankets, children playing; Iraqi parks: palm trees, fountains, plastic chairs and tea sellers.

Sky: clouds with real volume (bright tops, grey shaded bottoms) drifting slowly, crepuscular rays through gaps; at night a moon with its correct phase and craters, stars dense away from city lights, the Milky Way in the desert.

Cinematic look: anamorphic or 35 mm lens feel with shallow depth of field, motivated light with contrast and soft shadows, a deliberate colour grade (teal-orange or warm golden), slow purposeful camera moves (dolly-in, crane up, tracking side-on), 24 fps motion blur, subtle film grain.

Documentary realism: handheld camera with small natural shakes, available light, people not posing, candid moments, slightly imperfect framing that follows the action, natural colours, real ambient sound.

Vertical social video (9:16): the subject centred and close, important things in the middle so captions fit top and bottom, quick engaging start in the first second, energetic cuts or a single dynamic move, bright punchy colours, faces large and expressive.

Drone/aerial shot: smooth gliding movement high above, a slow reveal (rising over a building, flying forward over a river), the landscape and roads laid out in perspective, tiny moving cars and people, correct scale and shadows.

Slow motion: every physical detail visible – droplets hanging and falling slowly, hair and fabric floating, facial expressions changing gradually, dust particles drifting; the movement still follows physics, just slower.

Studio product shot: seamless clean background (white, black or a brand colour), a soft key light with a gentle gradient, a rim light outlining the product, a subtle reflection or soft shadow under it, perfectly sharp focus on the label.

3D cartoon style: stylised proportions (bigger heads and eyes), soft rounded shapes, smooth materials, bright clean colours and soft global illumination like modern animated films; characters still breathe, blink and react with exaggerated but readable expressions, and objects still obey gravity with squash and stretch.
